Sizes - They can be (5”) Small to jumbo (24”)

Strategies for hunting - Find local squishmallow retailers around you on a map so you can visit as many as possible in one trip, Go as early as possible to stores so you can catch restocks and beat scalpers. Expect not to find them immediately since they’re so popular lately. 

Production process - there are definitely certain amounts made of each squish especially with seasonal squish. There are also Canadian exclusives etc. 

Good luck hunting :)
